title: Trivial Kan fibrations lift against degreewise injections
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be a trivial Kan fibration of simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-trivial-kan-fibration], and let $i:Z\to W$ be a morphism of simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] for which every map $i_n:Z_n\to W_n$ is injective. For every pair of simplicial maps $a:Z\to X$ and $b:W\to Y$ satisfying $p\circ a=b\circ i$, there exists a simplicial map $c:W\to X$ with $c\circ i=a$ and $p\circ c=b$.
